# searchstax_restore (Resource)





## Import

Import an existing restore with `account_name/backup_id` or `account_name/deployment_uid/backup_id`.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_restore.example account_name/deployment_uid/backup_id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `backup_id` (String)

### Optional

- `deployment_uid` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)
- `status` (String)
